rationale: The SwiftUI emitter now resolves a bound control with no audio label and no node name by its existing pulpParamKey, and a key-only meter by its existing pulpMeterValueKey, instead of emitting the unbound placeholder. core/view/src/design_swift_codegen.cpp (binding_resolve_name only) selects design-ir-contract through core/view/src/design_*.cpp and render-assets-and-backends through core/view/**. test/test_design_swift_codegen.cpp and test/test_design_emitter_conformance.cpp select design-source-ingest through test/test_design_*; the conformance test projects a meter by its primitive when it carries no source family, and test/fixtures/emitter-conformance/allowlist.json drops the two SwiftUI kelvin binding gaps this closes. No public header, DesignIR schema or IR field changes: the fallback reads binding metadata that NativeBindingMetadata::parse already exposes. The change is limited to SwiftUI code generation and its tests; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
